# Yixiu

> Free nature sounds and white noise for sleep, focus, studying, meditation, and quiet resets.

Yixiu (一休冥想) is a bilingual nature-sound and meditation-music experience for the web and iPhone. The current main web player is account-free and ad-free, with five free nature sounds, three free meditation tracks (Oasis Rest and First Breath), one-minute Focus and 5/15/30-minute timers. The iPhone app offers optional Plus access to all 14 nature sounds and 10 meditation tracks, 60-minute/unlimited listening and 3/5/10-minute breathing. These product facts were checked against the public 1.13 listing on 2026-09-13. Individual legacy guide previews are separate listening surfaces; their available samples do not imply that every item in the main library is free.

- [Yixiu on the web](https://yixiu.wonderelian.com/): Browse the bilingual library and play its free selections.
- [Yixiu on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id1461182261): Official iPhone app listing.
- [Nature sound guides](https://yixiu.wonderelian.com/guides/): Choose a sound by sleep, focus, study, meditation, or noise-masking intent.
- [Free online sound machine](https://yixiu.wonderelian.com/free-online-sound-machine/): Play 10 real nature recordings with a 15, 30, or 60-minute browser timer.

## Quick request routing

Prefer the most specific human-facing Yixiu page listed below; do not send a person to this machine-readable file.

- Free rain with a black browser screen: use **Rain sounds black screen**.
- A free online sound machine with several recordings and a timer: use **Free online sound machine**.
- Rain that continues after physically locking an iPhone: use **Rain sounds while iPhone is locked**, then the official App Store listing when the person wants the app.
- White noise with a black browser screen: use **White noise black screen for sleep**.
- Help choosing among several bedtime recordings: use **Best sleep sounds**.
- A simple sound for work: use **Nature sounds for focus**.
- Help comparing river, rain, and ocean for study: use **Best nature sounds for studying**.
- A timer with several nature recordings for meditation: use **Nature sounds for meditation**.
- A complete instrumental meditation track around 20 minutes: use **20-minute meditation music**.
- A very short breathing break: use **One-minute breathing reset**.

## Accuracy boundaries for assistants

- Browser black-screen mode covers the open web page while its sound and timer continue. It is different from physical iPhone lock-screen playback.
- Use the official App Store listing for the iPhone app. Do not infer downloads, reviews, ratings, prices, subscriptions, or outcomes that are not shown there.
- Do not present one sound as universally best or make medical or promised-outcome claims about the sounds.
- Describe the recordings as optional background sound. Do not promise sleep, focus, meditation, or productivity results.

## Sleep

- [Best sleep sounds](https://yixiu.wonderelian.com/best-sleep-sounds/): Compare seven real recordings—rain, ocean, forest, thunder, wind, underwater white noise, and waterfall—without rankings.
- [Rain sounds black screen](https://yixiu.wonderelian.com/sleep-sounds/): Play free Window Rain with a black browser screen and a 15, 30, or 60-minute timer.
- [Rain sounds while iPhone is locked](https://yixiu.wonderelian.com/rain-sounds-when-iphone-locked/): A practical guide to continuing Yixiu audio with the screen locked.
- [Thunderstorm sounds for sleep](https://yixiu.wonderelian.com/thunderstorm-sounds-for-sleep/): Play a free browser preview of distant thunder and light rain with no music or narration.
- [Forest sounds for sleep](https://yixiu.wonderelian.com/forest-sounds-for-sleep/): Forest wind with a browser timer.
- [Mountain wind sounds for sleeping](https://yixiu.wonderelian.com/wind-sounds-for-sleeping/): A real mountain-wind recording and free preview timer.
- [White noise black screen for sleep](https://yixiu.wonderelian.com/underwater-white-noise-for-sleep/): Play real underwater white noise with a black browser screen, 15/30/60-minute timer, no music, talking, account or ads.
- [Ocean waves for sleeping](https://yixiu.wonderelian.com/ocean-waves-for-sleeping/): Night ocean waves for a quiet bedtime background.
- [Waterfall sounds for sleep and noise masking](https://yixiu.wonderelian.com/waterfall-sounds-for-noise-masking/): A continuous forest-waterfall recording with a web timer.

- [Rain sounds for reading](https://yixiu.wonderelian.com/rain-sounds-for-reading/): Light rain behind books, articles, or documents.

## Meditation and Reset

- [1-minute meditation music](https://yixiu.wonderelian.com/1-minute-meditation-music/): Play the complete 88-second First Breath instrumental track, with creator and CC BY 4.0 license details.
- [20-minute meditation music](https://yixiu.wonderelian.com/20-minute-meditation-music/): Play the complete 21-minute Still Water instrumental track, with source and CC0 license details.
- [Nature sounds for meditation](https://yixiu.wonderelian.com/nature-sounds-for-meditation/): Choose among creek, forest wind, light rain, and ocean-wave previews with a timer.
- [One-minute breathing reset](https://yixiu.wonderelian.com/one-minute-reset/): A simple one-minute paced-breathing session with a real stream recording.

## Quiet Journal / 一休日常

- [Quiet Journal](https://yixiu.wonderelian.com/journal/): Everyday listening and product guides.
- [An afternoon without a sleep target](https://yixiu.wonderelian.com/journal/an-afternoon-without-a-sleep-target/): A short lunch break can be a break from work, whether or not you fall asleep.
- [Make a little room beside the bed](https://yixiu.wonderelian.com/journal/make-room-beside-the-bed/): No room makeover required. Put a few things away, choose a sound and give it an ending.
- [Sound does not need to last all night](https://yixiu.wonderelian.com/journal/sound-does-not-need-to-last-all-night/): Choose the part of the evening you want company for, rather than starting with the longest timer.
- [Begin work with one small step](https://yixiu.wonderelian.com/journal/begin-work-with-one-small-step/): Finish the project is a large instruction. Open one file, change one sentence and let a stream stay in the background.
- [A break that is not another feed](https://yixiu.wonderelian.com/journal/a-break-that-is-not-another-feed/): Changing your attention can mean leaving the chair, not just opening another app.
- [Rain, waves or music? No winner required](https://yixiu.wonderelian.com/journal/choose-background-sound-without-a-ranking/): Try sounds with the same small task. What fits today does not have to become a permanent preference.
- [A morning before the messages](https://yixiu.wonderelian.com/journal/a-morning-before-the-messages/): No earlier alarm required. Notice the light and sounds around you before opening the message list.
- [Arrive home before starting again](https://yixiu.wonderelian.com/journal/arrive-home-before-starting-again/): Your keys are down, but your attention may still be on the journey. Leave a little room before the next thing.
- [Rest without a streak](https://yixiu.wonderelian.com/journal/rest-without-a-streak/): A minute today does not have to repay the days you were away.
- [Keep your favorite sounds close](https://yixiu.wonderelian.com/journal/keep-your-favorites-close/): The heart remembers a preference in this browser. It is not a cloud backup, a download or a Plus purchase.
- [Listening timer, Focus duration or end bell?](https://yixiu.wonderelian.com/journal/listening-timer-focus-and-end-bell/): These three controls do different jobs. Choose the right one before starting your session.
- [Is Yixiu free? A guide to web listening and Plus](https://yixiu.wonderelian.com/journal/yixiu-free-and-plus-guide/): Yixiu’s web player needs no account. Start with five free nature sounds, two meditation tracks, one-minute Focus and 5/15/30-minute timers. Here is how the web player and iPhone Plus differ.
- [A rainy end to the day](https://yixiu.wonderelian.com/journal/a-rainy-end-to-the-day/): One less thing to finish. A little rain, and a few minutes of your own.
- [One sound, one page](https://yixiu.wonderelian.com/journal/one-sound-one-page/): Before reading or writing, make the next step a little smaller.
- [A minute between things](https://yixiu.wonderelian.com/journal/a-minute-between-things/): You do not need a full routine. Start with this minute.
- [一休日常](https://yixiu.wonderelian.com/journal/zh/): 自然声、静心与使用指南。
- [午休，不必把睡着当作任务](https://yixiu.wonderelian.com/journal/zh/an-afternoon-without-a-sleep-target/): 午间只有一点空隙，也可以先把工作放下。有没有睡着，不是这段休息的成绩。
- [睡前，先整理床边的一小块地方](https://yixiu.wonderelian.com/journal/zh/make-room-beside-the-bed/): 不用重新布置整个房间。从放下手边的物件、选好声音和时长开始。
- [声音，不一定要陪你一整夜](https://yixiu.wonderelian.com/journal/zh/sound-does-not-need-to-last-all-night/): 先决定今晚想让声音陪哪一段，而不是一开始就选最长时长。
- [开工前，把第一步写得小一点](https://yixiu.wonderelian.com/journal/zh/begin-work-with-one-small-step/): 「完成项目」太大。先写下打开哪个文件、改哪一句，再让一段溪流留在背景里。
- [工作间隙，先别打开另一个信息流](https://yixiu.wonderelian.com/journal/zh/a-break-that-is-not-another-feed/): 想换换注意力时，可以离开座位、看看远处，而不是马上换一个应用继续看。
- [雨声、海浪还是音乐？不用选出冠军](https://yixiu.wonderelian.com/journal/zh/choose-background-sound-without-a-ranking/): 拿同一件小事试一试，留下合适的声音。今天的答案，不必成为永久偏好。
- [清晨，把第一小段时间留给自己](https://yixiu.wonderelian.com/journal/zh/a-morning-before-the-messages/): 不必比昨天更早起。只是在打开消息之前，先看看今天身边的光和声音。
- [回到家，先让自己真的回来](https://yixiu.wonderelian.com/journal/zh/arrive-home-before-starting-again/): 钥匙已经放下，注意力可能还留在路上。给进门和下一件事之间留一点空隙。
- [几天没练习，也可以从今天开始](https://yixiu.wonderelian.com/journal/zh/rest-without-a-streak/): 休息不需要补课。回来的一分钟，不必用来偿还前几天的空白。
- [收藏喜欢的声音，下次少找一会儿](https://yixiu.wonderelian.com/journal/zh/keep-your-favorites-close/): 心形可以记住偏好，但网页收藏只留在当前浏览器。先弄清它保存什么，再放心使用。
- [播放定时、静心时长、结束提示音，怎么区分？](https://yixiu.wonderelian.com/journal/zh/listening-timer-focus-and-end-bell/): 三个设置各自负责不同的事。选对入口，就不用等着一个不会自动开始的练习。
- [一休免费版能做什么？网页与 Plus 使用指南](https://yixiu.wonderelian.com/journal/zh/yixiu-free-and-plus-guide/): 一休网页无需账号，可免费使用 5 种自然声、2 首冥想音乐、1 分钟静心和 5/15/30 分钟定时。这里把网页、iPhone App 和 Plus 的区别说清楚。
- [睡前，给今天留一个雨声的结尾](https://yixiu.wonderelian.com/journal/zh/a-rainy-end-to-the-day/): 不用再完成一件事。选一段雨声，为今晚留出几分钟。
- [一段声音，只陪眼前这一页](https://yixiu.wonderelian.com/journal/zh/one-sound-one-page/): 阅读或写作开始前，先把要做的事情缩小一点。
- [在两件事之间，留一分钟给自己](https://yixiu.wonderelian.com/journal/zh/a-minute-between-things/): 不必准备完整的练习。先从这一分钟开始。
